_approach: Future garage doesn't do EDM-style risers — it adds texture instead. Bar 1 is near-silent (a lone clave tick), bar 2 adds a ghost rim, bar 3 layers in shaker and conga, and bar 4 lets a full swung hat pattern return at normal density — the groove is 'back' rather than a drop being announced. Ref: Plugg Supply 'How to Make Future Garage' (mid-track breakdowns 'go almost beatless, then return with a fuller hat pattern' — read here in reverse, as the way back in). (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
